_meta.title: Backroom cruising A+B research QA — positions 51–55
_meta.source_caveat: Archived alignment references all eight relevant original websites; this audit verifies select original pages plus current official sources, but not all logged-in site-specific material. Distinguish self-reported physical observations from online questions/check-ins; do not fabricate recent sexual encounters.

records.name: Neeltje Jans
records.location: Neeltje Jans barrier-island nature reserve, Oosterscheldekering; official Het Zeeuwse Landschap places nature site at Faelweg, 4675 RB Vrouwenpolder, with nature info GPS 51.630738322793,3.7023067474365. Saved nudist-beach coordinate 51.63073,3.68884 refers to west/sea-facing shore, NOT reserve visitor-information point. The different municipality labels are geographic descriptors, not separate islands.

recent_evidence.detail: Guestbook user states they visited previous week and saw men walking around high dunes, while alleging no harassment. Does NOT establish sexual encounters. This important post is newer than earlier file's 2022 observations.

records.access: Official land manager permits marked hiking routes and describes sensitive breeding habitats. Guestbook warns high dunes are out of bounds, and land manager generally does not grant permission for night activities. A listed route had temporary closure 'until October 15', but without a documented reopening check this cannot prove present route status. Coastal bathing unsupervised.
records.duplicates: Popcorn and Gays-Cruising both refer to same Neeltje Jans naturist shoreline under alternate region Vrouwenpolder/Kamperland; evidence of two web listings is not two physical venues.
corrections: Include July 26, 2026 physical observation of men walking (not sex), rather than treating all detailed visitor reports as only from 2022.
Do not direct to restricted high dunes or promise night access.
Do not confuse beach GPS with official nature reserve information-point GPS.

records.name: Meer en Bos Park
records.location: Official Den Haag Parks and Woods guide names Landgoed Meer en Bos and its Segmeer, with main entrance Heliotrooplaan and other access via Laan van Meerdervoort. Existing 52.06552,4.2312 is general estate point; source doesn't identify cruising corner.

recent_evidence.detail: Source check-in is an online status, not verified encounter or actual site visit.

records.access: Public historic estate with walking trails and playground; preserve ordinary municipal park rules and visitor privacy.
records.duplicates: No evidence of identical individual cruising subarea with other Den Haag parks; no merge.
corrections: Main entrance officially Heliotrooplaan; can cite instead of giving false path to isolated clearing.
No supported 2026 physical sexual activity or reliable busyness.

records.name: Parkplätze A10 zwischen Erkner und Rüdersdorf
records.location: Original gay-szene text covers multiple A10 parking/stopping areas, not one. Independent operator distinctly lists Seeberg West (A10, 15366 Neuenhagen) and Seeberg Ost (A10, 15366 Neuenhagen) with 24/7 rest service, separate approach and SANIFAIR WCs; Kalkberge area is another differently named rest area. Saved 52.43749,13.79567 is only original directory/general corridor marker.

recent_evidence.detail: Reports visits, specifics tied to individual stop rather than whole corridor.
Reports no encounter at Kalkberge; does not indicate whole A10 empty.
Mentions Seeberg West landscaping, not evidence of other stops' access or activity.

records.access: Seeberg West and Ost operators currently advertise all-day rest-service and designated parking. This confirms operational rest areas, NOT cruising activity at them or open forest access. Different A10 carriageway entrances are not interchangeable.
records.duplicates: Keep Seeberg West, Seeberg Ost, Kalkberge as distinct physical locations while tracking them beneath this historical general corridor listing; do not invent a single precise spot or merge forum anecdotes into one.
corrections: Existing listing refers to multiple places: treating it as singular 'Cruising Area' with one pin may materially mislead; this is a potential SPLIT or explicit corridor category for future owner-approved change.
Official Seeberg station owner site lists different rest area parking capacities, proving distinct facilities.
Do not generalize a 2026 Kalkberge negative visit to Seeberg.

records.name: Sandfläche im Jagen 87 des Grunewalds
records.location: Named Grunewald forestry compartment Jagen 87 sandy clearing, distinct from protected/renatured Sandgrube Jagen 86 nearby. Existing 52.4848,13.2384 is original gay-szene mapped point; without independent latest trail map don't describe as public legal access to specific secluded part.

recent_evidence.detail: Source visitors reported men sunbathing, walking toward adjacent woodland, and contact; some visitors report no sexual interaction. Not independently verified encounters.
Forum differentiates Jagen 87 from Jagen 86 and describes triangular sandy area roughly southwest of Jagen 86.

records.access: Public forest trails mixed with conservation/reforestation restrictions; no proof of permitted off-trail entry or public sexual activity. Do NOT reroute to fenced Jagen 86 conservation area.
records.duplicates: Do not conflate Jagen 87 with adjacent Jagen 86, Jagen 90, or Teufelssee solely on proximity.
corrections: Preserve source's specific Jagen 87 and original mapped location instead of using Jagen 86 photo/pin.
Qualify differing in-person men-present and no-encounter accounts.

records.name: Spektepark
records.location: Public Spektepark near Großer Spektesee, Falkenhagener Feld/Spandau. Official borough names the lake and park; existing 52.5449,13.1649 general landscape reference. Original cruising source describes a historical route from parking and shrubs; not verified current same trail.

recent_evidence.detail: Asks if cruising still takes place; does not report encounter.
Someone reports going twice with no meeting; predates 12month cutoff.

records.access: IMPORTANT current issues: Spandau health office advised NOT swimming or direct water contact in Großer Spektesee Aug 31, 2026 owing high bacterial results; a prior July 23 lift of an earlier warning was superseded by newer August notice. Berlin transport office closed pedestrian/cycle Spektelakesteg I bridge June 9, 2026 due to damage; no later reopening confirmation here. This does NOT prove all park walking paths or meeting areas closed.
records.duplicates: Do not equate Spektepark with nearby lake/water sports area as independent sex venues; no same-spot extra source established.
corrections: Material new access/safety notices Aug31 water quality and June9 footbridge closure absent from existing listing.
Treat July2026 question as no evidence of current cruising, and do not repeat unverified 2024 guidance near children’s playground as current location.
Do not infer restriction of whole park from water/one pedestrian bridge.

priority_issues: Spektepark 2026 water contact safety warning, bridge I closed; no evidence all park closed
Neeltje Jans July2026 site visit describes men around legally restricted dunes, no sex observed
A10 entry aggregates distinct motorway rest stops, cannot use one navigation pin for all
